description: Built for academic researchers, the Dewey app lets you search and explore datasets on the Dewey Platform without leaving ChatGPT. Ask in plain language, get back dataset details, coverage summaries, schemas, and downloadable samples. Spend less time hunting for data and more time using it. Trusted by thousands of academics across 500+ universities, Dewey unlocks 30+ premium data providers through one subscription.
